text: Dreaming of a master's degree in Europe?
Then the questions start.
Which university?
Which documents?
How do I get the visa?
And how much will it all cost?
Meet Estuvia.

The platform that turns
studying abroad into a clear,
guided plan.

Tell us about your background
and pick your destination.

Your path becomes rounds and missions,
from choosing your master's to

arriving in Spain, so you
always know your next step.
Stuck?

The Estuvia Mentor knows your journey,
explains each mission and points
you to official sources.

Nothing happens without
your confirmation.

Agenda AI plans your week around
your missions and official deadlines,
and only adds what you approve.
Plan your money, too.

What it costs to prepare, to live
there, and what the visa requires you to
prove.

Keep your documents
safe, compare housing,

plan your trip, and know
what to do when you land.
All connected to your journey.

Discover opportunities
from official sources,

and learn from students
on the same path.
Your future starts with a plan.
Start your journey today.
Estuvia.
